method: Every page rendered with Poppler and reviewed in six-page contact sheets; dense formula pages inspected at full rendering size. Final wording-only changes on pages 14 and 22 re-rendered and inspected.

findings.front_matter: Dedicated title/abstract page and complete single-page contents
findings.equations: Checked fractions, subscripts, long formulas, theorem blocks, and page transitions
findings.bibliography: Primary references and pinned source links readable; no isolated final entry

qualification: Visual and automated layout review, not mathematical formal certification.
